phase: exploratory raw-coordinate baseline added after stable pilot
cases: all six pilot cases with a<=0.5, without excluding any seeds
S_joint: Joint L-BFGS-B of two raw weights and centers, initialized at same state as NC by fitted initial coefficients. Same objective scaling, 300 iterations, 1000 evaluations, gtol1e-10, ftol1e-14. Weights unbounded; centers[-3,3].
S_vp: Raw-center variable projection with direct dense unregularized coefficient fits, same raw initial centers and outer settings. Singular/ill-conditioned coefficient failures recorded; no ridge or coefficient bound.
caveat: S_joint differs from NC both in representation and coefficient elimination; only S_vp isolates raw versus stable coordinates with coefficient fitting. NC remains the principal comparator.
